site.description.en: Classroom-grounded learning tools for Chinese Language education, designed and built by a practising teacher.
site.description.zh: 由一线华文教师独立设计与开发的课堂学习工具。

hero.tagline.en: Chinese Language Teacher · Independent EdTech Builder · Head of Department, Mother Tongue Languages
hero.tagline.zh: 华文教师 · 独立教育科技开发者 · 百德中学母语部主任

hero.intro.en: My work starts the same way in every medium: I notice a structural gap, then build something to close it. I teach Chinese Language, lead a Mother Tongue department, and design tools around problems that come out of real classrooms.
hero.intro.zh: 无论在哪一个领域，我的工作都始于同一件事：察觉结构上的缺口，然后动手把它补上。我教华文，主持母语部门，也针对课堂中真实浮现的问题，亲手做出相应的工具。

grid.subtitle.en: Smaller classroom tools, each built for one specific teaching problem.
grid.subtitle.zh: 为解决某一个具体教学问题而做的小型课堂工具。

talks.subtitle.en: Sharing what I build so other teachers can adapt it rather than start from zero, and finding people to build with along the way.
talks.subtitle.zh: 把做出来的东西分享出去，让其他老师可以直接借鉴，而不必从零开始；也在这个过程中，遇到愿意一起做的人。

approach.body1.en: Two ideas consistently shape my design decisions: Self-Determination Theory, which holds that students need autonomy, competence and relatedness to stay engaged, and Assessment for Learning, where feedback exists to move learning forward rather than to rank students.
approach.body1.zh: 有两个想法始终影响着我的设计决定：自我决定理论（SDT）认为，学生需要自主感、胜任感与归属感，才能持续投入；以及促进学习的评价（AfL）：反馈的意义在于推动学习，而不是给学生排名。

approach.body2.en: That is easy to say and hard to hold onto once you are actually building. The principles below are the ones I refuse to trade away for convenience.
approach.body2.zh: 这话说来容易，真正动手开发时却很难守住。以下几条，是我不愿为了方便而妥协的原则。

approach.principle1Body.en: A wrong answer does not erase progress already earned. I want attempting something difficult to feel safe: a mistake can interrupt a streak or send a student back for more practice, but it does not undo earlier effort.
approach.principle1Body.zh: 答错，不会抹去学生已经挣得的进度。我希望尝试难题这件事本身是安全的：失误可以中断连胜，也可以让学生回去多练几遍，但不会否定先前的努力。

approach.principle2Title.en: Students have meaningful choice over challenge
approach.principle2Title.zh: 挑战的难度，学生有实质的选择权

approach.principle2Body.en: Where meaningful choice is possible, students decide what to practise and how far to stretch. The system can recommend a next step, but it should not turn that recommendation into a fixed lane. The aim is challenge that stays within reach.
approach.principle2Body.zh: 在可以选择的地方，由学生自己决定练什么、挑战到什么程度。系统可以建议下一步，但不该把建议变成一条固定的轨道。目标是让挑战始终在够得着的范围内。

approach.principle3Title.en: Feedback lands before the next attempt
approach.principle3Title.zh: 反馈必须赶在下一次尝试之前

approach.principle3Body.en: In a practice tool, feedback is most useful when a student can act on it straight away. Wherever possible the loop closes within the same session: attempt, feedback, adjustment, another attempt.
approach.principle3Body.zh: 在练习工具里，反馈最有用的时刻，是学生还能立刻拿它做点什么的时候。只要做得到，这个循环就在同一堂课内完成：尝试、反馈、调整、再试一次。

contact.subtitle.en: Write to me if you would like to know more, or if there is something we could build together.
contact.subtitle.zh: 若想进一步了解，或有合作的想法，欢迎来信。

error.dataBody.en: This page reads its content from JSON files, which browsers block when a page is opened directly from disk. Serve the folder over HTTP instead: see README.md.
error.dataBody.zh: 本页内容从 JSON 档案载入，而浏览器会阻止直接从硬盘打开的页面读取档案。请以 HTTP 方式启动本资料夹：详见 README.md。

specimen.meta.zh: 麻胶版画 · 手工刻版 · 2015

specimen.note.en: The printmaking runs on the same instinct as the software: look closely at an ordinary thing, find the structure holding it up, then cut away everything that is not that structure. This is the block printing quietly behind every page here.
specimen.note.zh: 版画与软件其实出于同一种本能：仔细观察一件寻常的东西，找出支撑它的结构，然后把不属于那个结构的部分，全部刻去。本站每一页的底纹，正是这块版。

specimen.alt.en: A sheet of block-printed Singapore payphones repeating across the paper, one of them hand-coloured orange.
specimen.alt.zh: 满纸重复印刷的新加坡公用电话版画，其中一台以手工上了橙色。
